description: This PHP class 'AccessTokenEntity' represents an OAuth2 access token entity within the OrangeHRM system. It implements methods for managing token identifiers, expiry times, associated user and client information, and attached scopes, facilitating OAuth2 token handling and storage.

classes.name: AccessTokenEntity
classes.description: Represents an OAuth2 access token, managing token data such as identifier, expiry, associated user, client, and scopes.

methods.name: setPrivateKey
methods.description: Placeholder method, not used as JWT is not employed.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns an encrypted string representation of the token identifier.

methods.name: getExpiryDateTime
methods.description: Returns the expiry DateTimeImmutable object for the token.

methods.name: setExpiryDateTime
methods.description: Overrides the expiry time to UTC, adding the configured TTL.

methods.name: getUserIdentifier
methods.description: Returns the ID of the user associated with the token, if any.

methods.name: setUserIdentifier
methods.description: Sets the user ID linked to the token.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Retrieves the client associated with the token.

methods.name: setClient
methods.description: Assigns a client to the token.

methods.name: addScope
methods.description: Adds a scope to the token.

methods.name: getScopes
methods.description: Returns all scopes attached to the token.
